title: Read the trampoline mechanism
description: You can follow deferred calls through a loop and inspect a small self-call detector.

steps.description: The setup raises the integer string-conversion cap. The two factorial definitions provide the recursive forms discussed in the exercises.
Thunk stores a function and its arguments. Calling the object invokes that stored function.

steps.question: What does the trampoline do when its current result is another Thunk?
steps.answer: It calls that Thunk and checks the resulting value again.

steps.description: fact_tramp returns a deferred call for the next step. The demonstrations request factorial values, with the final call formatting only the last five digits.
The detector recognizes a Return containing a call to the requested function name. For If, it searches either branch.
The constructed body contains such a call in its else-branch, so the final check requests True. The supplied recording stops after the first factorial output.
